state.context: Offline-first mobile home workout PWA. Review only the stated code and test evidence, not an unseen app. A release gate separately requires complete reviewed exercise motion media and independent human movement review.
state.movement: The repo has 53 line-SVG animations. It has zero local complete-motion MP4/WebM/GIF demonstrations and no qualified human movement review. Five currently programmed exercises have no matching demonstration and are labelled skippable. The UI warns line animation is not complete instruction.
state.help: During a live workout, opening the in-app demonstration pauses the timer, hides the external YouTube link, and returns to the same step and remaining count. A local checkpoint implementation now restores step/count in a paused state after page reload in a focused Playwright test. Boss test timer recovery after warmup and real iOS eviction are not independently verified.
state.timing: For 70 combinations of band availability, level, and weekday, estimated seconds equal the sum of rep×tempo, holds, rest, preparation and gear changes in a Playwright test. Per-exercise dose rationale and external coach validation have not been delivered.
state.program: Seven-day plan has two shoulder/push days, two pull days, one lower strength day, one recovery day and a Sunday Boss test. No-band variants avoid wall and door anchors. The no-band pull variant admits limited pulling load. Progression is fixed by level and does not use recorded completed reps, perceived exertion or pain.
state.navigation: The training view shows checkpoint type, current and next action, set, progress, help, pause, skip and exit. Local accessibility audit of training found zero text contrast and touch-target failures at settled state. No independent user study or real-device test has been done.
